 Coram: Honourable Justice Smt. Soni Shrivastava
 Oral Order
5 07-08-2025
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the OP.No.2 learned APP for the State.

2. Petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and section  of the D.P.Act.
3.
The case is one under section 498A and the petitioner is husband.
The complaint case discloses an allegation of demand of dowry and torture.
The matter had earlier been sent to the Mediation Center for resolution of disputes but the same had failed.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegations made in the complaint is not correct and as a matter of fact, the marriage has been solemnized in the year 2018 and the petitioner has always been ready to keep his wife with full honour Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.76633 of 2024(5) dt.07-08-2025 and dignity.
This fact also appears from the bail rejection order wherein it has been stated that the complainant has refused to go in the company of petitioner.
Further the present complaint was lodged after inordinate delay of 9 days, although the alleged occurrence took place on 26.03.2021.

The learned counsel for the petitioner has next submitted that it is his oral instruction that OP.No.2 has re-married and that is the reason, she does not appear in the Mediation Center for resolution of dispute.
5. The learned counsel for the O.P.No. 2 however opposes the bail and supports the allegation made in the complaint petition.

sentences.text: Considering all the above mentioned facts and circumstances, let the petitioner, in the event of his arrest/ surrender within a period of four weeks from today, be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court below where the case is pending/ successor court in Complaint Case No. 610C of 2021, subject to condition as laid down under section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C and subject to the further condition that the petitioner shall co-operate in investigation/ trial.

(Soni Shrivastava, J) N.K/-
